job.job_description:
We are looking for a passionate and experienced Full Stack Developer who has hands-on expertise in React.js on the frontend, Python (preferably with frameworks like Django or Flask) on the backend, and solid knowledge of relational and/or NoSQL databases. The ideal candidate will be part of a fast-paced team working on scalable, high-performance web applications and platforms.

Key Responsibilities:

Design, develop, and maintain scalable and secure full stack applications.

Work closely with UI/UX designers, product managers, and backend engineers to deliver high-quality solutions.

Build reusable components and front-end libraries using React.js.

Develop RESTful APIs and backend services using Python (Django/Flask/FastAPI).

Design and manage robust database schemas and optimize queries (SQL and NoSQL).

Ensure code quality, performance, and responsiveness.

Participate in code reviews and agile development processes.

Troubleshoot and resolve application issues and bugs.

Stay updated with the latest trends in frontend and backend development.



Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying.
